comment.body:
Thanks for saving the fail-fast stack. It already narrows the crash to a shared ListItemsView/template-selection path, but it still does not say what content triggered it. Please provide:

1. The exact steps from launching CmdPal to the crash, including the visible page or provider on the home page.
2. Whether any search text, extension result, or adaptive-card-backed item was visible just before the crash.
3. A dump or any extra stowed-exception/crash diagnostics from the next reproducing run, if available.

That will let maintainers map the stack to one concrete ListItemsView content path.
